info.name: Week 7 — Nutrition & Meal Planning (Full Setup)
info.description:
Complete test collection for Week 7: Nutrition & Meal Planning.

**DB mới hoàn toàn** — Collection bao gồm:
- 0️⃣ SETUP: Register, Login, Create Pregnancy, Create Weight Goal
- 1️⃣ Reference Data (food items, nutrients)
- 2️⃣ Food Preferences CRUD
- 3️⃣ Nutrition Notes CRUD
- 4️⃣ Query Specs
- 5️⃣ Meal Plan Generate (AI)
- 6️⃣ Meal Plan List/Detail/Delete
- 7️⃣ Meal Day Detail
- 8️⃣ Recipe Detail
- 9️⃣ Feedback
- 🔟 Authorization
- 1️⃣1️⃣ Edge Cases

**Cách dùng:**
1. Set variable `baseUrl` = https://localhost:PORT (hoặc http://)
2. Chạy folder "0 - SETUP" trước
3. Chạy các folder theo thứ tự 1 → 11
4. Các biến (token, pregnancyId, ...) tự động lưu từ response
